title: Charge Session Dwell Time After Full
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Rivian telemetry, ChargePoint session exports, PlugShare trip logs, Smartcar, and OBD-II / home-charger data via APIs, CSV exports, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=evcharger:session
| stats avg(post_charge_parked_min) as avg_dwell_min by site_name
| where avg_dwell_min>30
| sort - avg_dwell_min
description: Uses EV charging session exports telemetry to monitor how long the vehicle stayed parked after charge completion in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for sites where charging etiquette or workflow is slipping, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest EV charging session exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Site ranking by post-charge dwell minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how long the vehicle stayed parked after charge completion so you can spot sites where charging etiquette or workflow is slipping before it becomes annoying.
